$Comment: The temple hub's doorkeeper, standing in the Forgotten Temple on the open side of the landing, ten blocks along negative X from the temple's arrival spot (the hosts and the guide other mods stand there keep their own spots). Press F opens its conversation, whose answer sends the player into the hub's shared copy through the Instance destination; leaving the hub by its porter brings them back here. The temple is a place nobody can fight or build in, so the doorkeeper is a placed character and never a block. Retune the spot in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json, or switch the way in off there with { "Zc_Hub_Doorkeeper": { "Enabled": false } }.
Name: Zc_Hub_Doorkeeper
